name: ShowroomPipeline
description: The default pipeline extended for a model showroom: the sun's shadows from a virtual shadow map (an 8-level clipmap of 4096x4096 virtual texels, only the pages visible pixels need backed by a cached physical pool), sphere and rectangle lights (rectangles by linearly transformed cosines, from the fitted table ltc.bin) with soft ray-traced shadows where the device has ray queries, and the default pipeline's cascades kept as a preset to compare against. Settings are scene.custom.default.* and scene.custom.showroom.* values; see README.md.
